screen.subject: 販売数と人員配置について

lines.en: Hello, and welcome to Kamaru Business Japanese.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today is lesson 12: 25 words — company & personnel.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: First, let's listen to a meeting of three colleagues.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Let's begin. We'll go through the items below in the materials in order.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: First, sales volume. This year we fell below last year.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: What was the cause?
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: We couldn't draw customers into the large stores as we had hoped.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: Shareholders are asking for an explanation too. We need to get our products' strengths across better.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Yes. Deliveries to a new business partner also start next month.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Good. Next, staffing. I'd like to plan next year's work with the right person in the right place.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: I hear Accounting has more office work and isn't staffed enough.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Let's also consider hiring someone with accounting experience from outside.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Interviews are planned for next month.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: It's important that senior staff and colleagues teach new people properly.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Exactly. We have customs that go back to when the company was founded, so let's pass those on early.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Also, sales staff are out of the office most of the time, so I'd like to settle how we keep in touch.
lines.name: 佐藤

lines.en: All right. Please put together a proposal by the next meeting.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Now let's go through today's words one by one. First: sales & dealings.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: How many of a product were sold.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Sales of the new product passed ten thousand units.
lines.name: 中村

segments.meaning: falling below the previous year's figures

lines.en: Falling below the previous year's figure.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Sales this month were below last year.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Large in size or scale.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: A large supermarket opened near the station.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Drawing in customers.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll bring in more customers with an event.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Someone who owns shares in a company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We'll report this year's results to shareholders.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: A strong point that beats the rest.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This product's strong point is that it is light.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Companies exchanging goods or money; also written 取引.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We've dealt with that company for a long time.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Supplying ordered goods to a client.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We're delivering equipment to the hospital next week.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Next: people & work.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Hiring people, or adopting ideas.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This year we hired five new employees.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Meeting someone in person to talk with them.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I have a job interview tomorrow.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Putting people or things in set places.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We placed the new staff at reception.
lines.name: 中村

segments.meaning: the right person in the right place

lines.en: Giving people the work that suits them.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Let's build the team with the right people in the right places.
lines.name: 木村

segments.meaning: senior colleague, one's senior (at school or work)

lines.en: Someone who joined the same company before you.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I ask a senior colleague when I don't understand something.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: A co-worker in the same workplace.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I had lunch with a colleague.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: The work you do every day at a company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today's work finishes at five.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Office work such as preparing and filing papers.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: I do office work.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Being out of the office, for work for example.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The department manager is out at the moment.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Last: about the company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Your own company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Our company was founded ten years ago.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: Outside the company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: We also asked people outside the company for their views.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Founding a company or school.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This year marks the company's 50th anniversary.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: A custom that has continued for a long time.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: This company has a custom of morning meetings.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Managing the money coming into and going out of a company.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Accounting work needs accuracy.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: The department that does the accounting.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Hand your receipts in to Accounting.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Written below.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please see below for details.
lines.name: 木村

lines.en: An individual item or matter.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Please read the precautions carefully.
lines.name: 中村

lines.en: Finally, let's check with a quiz. Choose the answer from 1 to 4.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 1. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 前年割れ, below last year.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Which word means a co-worker in the same workplace?

lines.en: Question 2. Which word means a co-worker in the same workplace?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 3: 同僚.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: The department manager is ___ at the moment.

lines.en: Question 3. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 4: 外出, out of the office.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Question 4. Which word goes in the brackets?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 1: 下記, below.
lines.name: ナレーター

segments.promptEn: Which means giving people the work that suits them?

lines.en: Question 5. Which means giving people the work that suits them?
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: The answer is 2: 適材適所.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Today we studied 25 words: company & personnel.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Review them again in the app's word list.
lines.name: ナレーター

lines.en: Good work today. See you in the next lesson.
lines.name: ナレーター
